name: 1.22.0-beta.23
notes: Find variants by hand: choosing “By hand” no longer asks for the base picture or how small a change to catch; both are set inside (the first image is the base to start with, and “Use all of it as the base” in “Build the base” makes any version the base).
The two pictures being compared are now chosen side by side, at the top of the panel (“Compare” and “With”).
Making a layer keeps what you chose with the brushes, instead of starting the choice over.
The “Take away” brush now shows where it paints (in red) while you paint.
